title: error codes: an undeclared hook `onError` abort answers the data door with a code-less 400; give it a ledgered ADR-0112 code (#27508 code half)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

carries the code half of #27508; #27508 keeps the log half (`logUnexpectedRouteError` stops logging the abort as unhandled), dispatched in `domain:server`.

## What is wrong

A hook whose `onError` (or body) aborts with free text, without a declared refusal code, is answered on the `/data` door with a 400 that carries no `code`. A client cannot tell it from any other unclassified 400.

Re-check on `main`: `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts` (the `/data` classification door), `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` (`mapDataError`), and `grep -n -i "hook" packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` (no hook-abort code in the ADR-0112 ledger today).

## Expected

An undeclared hook abort answers with one ledgered ADR-0112 code, so the client SDK can map it. Declared refusals keep their declared codes.

## Constraints

- Ruling `6431311681` (#26170, letter A): hook refusals are declared by code; "an undeclared code is refused loudly". This card names the code an UNDECLARED abort answers; it does not reopen letter A.
- A new public wire code is `Clause-②: yes` (SKILL.md: 错误码已发布面), a `packages/spec` edit: the spec lane's. Owes a contract review before approval. Triage `6498814060` on #27508 split it here (p2).
